CUDA_C_16BF.doc: The data type is 16-bit complex bfloat floating-point

CUDA_C_16F.doc: The data type is 16-bit complex IEEE-754 floating-point

CUDA_C_32F.doc: The data type is 32-bit complex IEEE-754 floating-point

CUDA_C_64F.doc: The data type is 64-bit complex IEEE-754 floating-point

CUDA_R_16BF.doc: The data type is 16-bit bfloat floating-point

CUDA_R_16F.doc: The data type is 16-bit IEEE-754 floating-point

CUDA_R_32F.doc: The data type is 32-bit IEEE-754 floating-point

CUDA_R_64F.doc: The data type is 64-bit IEEE-754 floating-point

CUSPARSE_ACTION_NUMERIC.doc: the operation is performed on data and indices.

CUSPARSE_ACTION_SYMBOLIC.doc: the operation is performed only on indices.

CUSPARSE_DIAG_TYPE_NON_UNIT.doc: The matrix diagonal has non-unit elements.

CUSPARSE_DIAG_TYPE_UNIT.doc: The matrix diagonal has unit elements.

CUSPARSE_DIRECTION_COLUMN.doc: The matrix should be parsed by columns.

CUSPARSE_DIRECTION_ROW.doc: The matrix should be parsed by rows.

CUSPARSE_FILL_MODE_LOWER.doc: The lower triangular part is stored.

CUSPARSE_FILL_MODE_UPPER.doc: The upper triangular part is stored.

CUSPARSE_FORMAT_BLOCKED_ELL.doc: The matrix is stored in Blocked-Ellpack (Blocked-ELL) format

CUSPARSE_FORMAT_BSR.doc: The matrix is stored in Block Sparse Row (BSR) format

CUSPARSE_FORMAT_COO.doc: The matrix is stored in Coordinate (COO) format organized in _Structure of Arrays (SoA)_ layout

CUSPARSE_FORMAT_CSC.doc: The matrix is stored in Compressed Sparse Column (CSC) format

CUSPARSE_FORMAT_CSR.doc: The matrix is stored in Compressed Sparse Row (CSR) format

CUSPARSE_FORMAT_SLICED_ELL.doc: The matrix is stored in Sliced-Ellpack (Sliced-ELL) format

CUSPARSE_INDEX_BASE_ONE.doc: The base index is one (Fortran compatibility).

CUSPARSE_INDEX_BASE_ZERO.doc: The base index is zero (C compatibility).

CUSPARSE_OPERATION_CONJUGATE_TRANSPOSE.doc: The conjugate transpose operation is selected.

CUSPARSE_ORDER_COL.doc: The matrix is stored in column-major

CUSPARSE_ORDER_ROW.doc: The matrix is stored in row-major

CUSPARSE_POINTER_MODE_DEVICE.doc: The scalars are passed by reference on the device.

CUSPARSE_POINTER_MODE_HOST.doc: The scalars are passed by reference on the host.

CUSPARSE_SDDMM_ALG_DEFAULT.doc: Default algorithm. It supports batched computation.

CUSPARSE_SOLVE_POLICY_NO_LEVEL.doc: no level information is generated and used.

CUSPARSE_SPGEMM_ALG1.doc: Algorithm 1 * Invokes `cusparseSpGEMM_compute` twice. The first invocation provides an upper bound of the memory required for the computation. * The required memory is generally several times larger of the actual memory used. * The user can provide an arbitrary buffer size bufferSize2 in the second invocation. If it is not sufficient, the routine will returns `CUSPARSE_STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES` status. * Provides better performance than other algorithms. * Provides deterministic (bit-wise) results for each run.

CUSPARSE_SPGEMM_ALG2.doc: Algorithm 2 * Invokes `cusparseSpGEMM_estimateMemory` to get the amount of the memory required for the computation. * Requires less memory for the computation than Algorithm 1. * Performance is lower than Algorithm 1, higher than Algorithm 3. * Provides deterministic (bit-wise) results for each run.

CUSPARSE_SPGEMM_ALG3.doc: Algorithm 3 * Computes the intermediate products in chunks, one chunk at a time. * Invokes `cusparseSpGEMM_estimateMemory` to get the amount of the memory required for the computation. * The user can control the amount of required memory by changing the chunk size via `chunk_fraction`. * The chunk size is a fraction of total intermediate products: `chunk_fraction * (*num_prods)`. * Provides deterministic (bit-wise) results for each run.

CUSPARSE_SPGEMM_CSR_ALG_DETERMINITIC.doc: Provides deterministic (bit-wise) structure for the output matrix and value computation for each run.

CUSPARSE_SPMAT_DIAG_TYPE.doc: Indicates if the matrix diagonal entries are unity

CUSPARSE_SPMAT_FILL_MODE.doc: Indicates if the lower or upper part of a matrix is stored in sparse storage

CUSPARSE_SPMM_ALG_DEFAULT.doc: Default algorithm for any sparse matrix format

CUSPARSE_SPMM_BSR_ALG1.doc: Algorithm 1 for BSR sparse matrix format * It provides deterministic result * It requires no additional memory * It supports only `opA == CUSPARSE_OPERATION_NON_TRANSPOSE` * It does not support `CUDA_C_16F` and `CUDA_C_16BF` data types * It does not support column-major blocks in `A`

CUSPARSE_SPMM_COO_ALG1.doc: Algorithm 1 for COO sparse matrix format * May provide better performance for small number of nnz * Provides the best performance with column-major layout * It supports batched computation * May produce slightly different results during different runs with the same input parameters

CUSPARSE_SPMM_COO_ALG2.doc: Algorithm 2 for COO sparse matrix format * It provides deterministic result * Provides the best performance with column-major layout * In general, slower than Algorithm 1 * It supports batched computation * It requires additional memory * If `opA != CUSPARSE_OPERATION_NON_TRANSPOSE`, it is identical to `CUSPARSE_SPMM_COO_ALG1`

CUSPARSE_SPMM_COO_ALG3.doc: Algorithm 3 for COO sparse matrix format * May provide better performance for large number of nnz * May produce slightly different results during different runs with the same input parameters

CUSPARSE_SPMM_COO_ALG4.doc: Algorithm 4 for COO sparse matrix format * Provides better performance with row-major layout * It supports batched computation * May produce slightly different results during different runs with the same input parameters

CUSPARSE_SPMM_CSR_ALG1.doc: Algorithm 1 for CSR/CSC sparse matrix format * Provides the best performance with column-major layout * It supports batched computation * It requires additional memory * May produce slightly different results during different runs with the same input parameters

CUSPARSE_SPMM_CSR_ALG2.doc: Algorithm 2 for CSR/CSC sparse matrix format * Provides the best performance with row-major layout * It supports batched computation * It requires additional memory * May produce slightly different results during different runs with the same input parameters

CUSPARSE_SPMM_CSR_ALG3.doc: Algorithm 3 for CSR sparse matrix format * It provides deterministic result * It requires additional memory * It supports only CSR matrix and `opA == CUSPARSE_OPERATION_NON_TRANSPOSE` * It does not support `opB == CUSPARSE_OPERATION_CONJUGATE_TRANSPOSE` * It does not support `CUDA_C_16F and CUDA_C_16BF` data types

CUSPARSE_SPMM_OP_ALG_DEFAULT.doc: Default algorithm for any sparse matrix format

CUSPARSE_SPMVOP_ALG1.doc: Deterministic algorithm. Supports updating the values of `matA` between calls to `cusparseSpMVOp()` without rebuilding the descriptor or the execution plan, either in-place or via `cusparseCsrSetPointers()`.

CUSPARSE_SPMVOP_ALG2.doc: Alternative deterministic algorithm. Compared to `CUSPARSE_SPMVOP_ALG1`, it may offer higher performance at the cost of significantly more buffer usage and more expensive preprocessing in `cusparseSpMVOp_createDescr()`. Does not support updating the values of `matA` between calls without rebuilding the descriptor and the execution plan.

CUSPARSE_SPMV_ALG_DEFAULT.doc: Default algorithm for any sparse matrix format.

CUSPARSE_SPMV_BSR_ALG1.doc: Default algorithm for BSR sparse matrix format. Provides deterministic (bit-wise) results for each run. Supports only `opA == CUSPARSE_OPERATION_NON_TRANSPOSE`. Supports both row-major and column-major block layouts in `A`.

CUSPARSE_SPMV_COO_ALG1.doc: Default algorithm for COO sparse matrix format. May produce slightly different results during different runs with the same input parameters.

CUSPARSE_SPMV_COO_ALG2.doc: Provides deterministic (bit-wise) results for each run. If `opA != CUSPARSE_OPERATION_NON_TRANSPOSE`, it is identical to `CUSPARSE_SPMV_COO_ALG1`.

CUSPARSE_SPMV_CSR_ALG1.doc: Default algorithm for CSR/CSC sparse matrix format. May produce slightly different results during different runs with the same input parameters.

CUSPARSE_SPMV_CSR_ALG2.doc: Provides deterministic (bit-wise) results for each run. If `opA != CUSPARSE_OPERATION_NON_TRANSPOSE`, it is identical to `CUSPARSE_SPMV_CSR_ALG1`.

CUSPARSE_SPMV_SELL_ALG1.doc: Default algorithm for Sliced Ellpack sparse matrix format. Provides deterministic (bit-wise) results for each run.

CUSPARSE_SPSM_UPDATE_DIAGONAL.doc: Updates the diagonal part of the matrix with diagonal values stored in `newValues` array. That is, `newValues` has the new diagonal values only

CUSPARSE_SPSM_UPDATE_GENERAL.doc: Updates the sparse matrix values with values of `newValues` array

CUSPARSE_SPSV_UPDATE_DIAGONAL.doc: Updates the diagonal part of the matrix with diagonal values stored in `newValues` array. That is, `newValues` has the new diagonal values only

CUSPARSE_SPSV_UPDATE_GENERAL.doc: Updates the sparse matrix values with values of `newValues` array

CUSPARSE_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED.doc: Resource allocation failed inside the cuSPARSE library. This is usually caused by a device memory allocation (`cudaMalloc()`) or by a host memory allocation failure **To correct:** prior to the function call, deallocate previously allocated memory as much as possible

CUSPARSE_STATUS_ARCH_MISMATCH.doc: The function requires a feature absent from the device architecture **To correct:** compile and run the application on a device with appropriate compute capability

CUSPARSE_STATUS_EXECUTION_FAILED.doc: The GPU program failed to execute. This is often caused by a launch failure of the kernel on the GPU, which can be caused by multiple reasons **To correct:** check that the hardware, an appropriate version of the driver, and the cuSPARSE library are correctly installed

CUSPARSE_STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES.doc: The resources for the computation, such as GPU global or shared memory, are not sufficient to complete the operation. The error can also indicate that the current computation mode (e.g. bit size of sparse matrix indices) does not allow to handle the given input

CUSPARSE_STATUS_INTERNAL_ERROR.doc: An internal cuSPARSE operation failed **To correct:** check that the hardware, an appropriate version of the driver, and the cuSPARSE library are correctly installed. Also, check that the memory passed as a parameter to the routine is not being deallocated prior to the routine completion

CUSPARSE_STATUS_INVALID_VALUE.doc: An unsupported value or parameter was passed to the function (a negative vector size, for example) **To correct:** ensure that all the parameters being passed have valid values

CUSPARSE_STATUS_MATRIX_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTE.doc: The matrix type is not supported by this function. This is usually caused by passing an invalid matrix descriptor to the function **To correct:** check that the fields in `cusparseMatDescr_t descrA` were set correctly

CUSPARSE_STATUS_NOT_INITIALIZED.doc: The cuSPARSE library was not initialized. This is usually caused by the lack of a prior call, an error in the CUDA Runtime API called by the cuSPARSE routine, or an error in the hardware setup **To correct:** call `cusparseCreate()` prior to the function call; and check that the hardware, an appropriate version of the driver, and the cuSPARSE library are correctly installed The error also applies to generic APIs ([cuSPARSE Generic APIs](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cusparse/index.html#cusparse-generic-api-reference)) for indicating a matrix/vector descriptor not initialized

CUSPARSE_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED.doc: The operation or data type combination is currently not supported by the function

MAJOR_VERSION.doc: Enumerator to query the major version

MINOR_VERSION.doc: Enumerator to query the minor version

PATCH_LEVEL.doc: Number to identify the patch level

boost_val.doc: boost value to replace a numerical zero

chunk_fraction.doc: The fraction of total intermediate products being computed in a chunk. Used by `CUSPARSE_SPGEMM_ALG3` only. Value is in range (0,1].

csrValA_valM.doc: <type> array of `nnz`$( =$`csrRowPtrA(m)`$-$`csrRowPtrA(0)`$)$ nonzero elements of matrix `A`.

enable_boost.doc: disable boost by `enable_boost=0`; otherwise, boost is enabled

num_prods.doc: Pointer to a 64-bit integer that stores the number of intermediate products calculated by `cusparseSpGEMM_workEstimation`
